message.content: The most iconic and globally recognized landmark in Paris is the **Eiffel Tower** (Tour Eiffel). Built for the 1889 Exposition Universelle (World’s Fair), it stands at 330 m tall and offers panoramic views of the city from its three observation decks. It’s a must‑visit symbol of French engineering and romance.
